title: Media Manager Lazy Load
text:
## Media Manager Lazy Load
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000049983
When the Media Manager holds a large number of images, a lazy-load option appears within the manager. Two controls are available:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12134919867/original/vqLivbhYa1R9jjgRRJfTmo9DWN1lHLsXHw.png?1700856680 | alt: ]

## Load More
Loads an additional 10 images per click, allowing fast browsing through the folder.

## Load All
Loads every image in the folder at once.
NOTE: Selecting Load All may take several seconds to several minutes to complete, depending on how many images the folder contains.
